categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Lyric Robot Automation Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment. Its main business segments include equipment for new energy sectors such as power lithium batteries, 3C lithium batteries, solid-state batteries, energy storage, perovskite, and hydrogen energy, as well as smart logistics, ICT, AI computing power, and automotive parts. The company offers comprehensive digital factory solutions covering the entire production chain from specialized machines to full production lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies including intelligent sensing, control, execution, digitalization, smart warehousing, laser applications, and vacuum technology. It has developed proprietary equipment such as dual-layer wide coating machines, laser cutting and slitting machines, high-speed winding machines, and integrated formation and capacity testing machines. The firm emphasizes R&D in laser welding, automated assembly, digital twin technology, and flexible manufacturing systems, supporting high precision and automation in battery and semiconductor equipment production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in the new energy industry, including major lithium battery manufacturers and automotive companies such as ATL, CATL, BYD, Guoxuan, Sunwoda, GAC, Envision Power, and others. The company also serves clients in the photovoltaic, hydrogen energy, ICT, AI computing, and automotive parts sectors. Its products cater to global markets with a focus on high-end intelligent manufacturing solutions for battery production and related industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Huizhou, Ningde, Nantong, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Germany, Poland, the United States, Canada, South Korea, Japan, and Hungary. It has established R&D centers, service centers, and production facilities across these regions to support local customer needs and global market expansion, including significant presence in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lyric Robot Automation operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of intelligent manufacturing equipment for battery and semiconductor production lines. It provides specialized machinery and complete production line solutions, serving as a critical equipment supplier to battery manufacturers and related industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a strategic focus on high-precision, high-stability, and cost-effective equipment development. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining over 10% of revenue allocated to research activities. Key R&D directions include solid-state battery equipment, laser processing technologies, digital twin platforms, AI-enabled smart manufacturing, and flexible assembly systems. The firm aims to expand its product portfolio vertically and horizontally, enhancing global competitiveness and entering emerging sectors like AI computing and perovskite solar cells.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment and integrated production lines. The company employs a direct sales model with staged payment terms based on order milestones, including prepayments, delivery, acceptance, and warranty completion. Additional revenue streams include value-added services such as equipment upgrades and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lyric Robot Automation is positioned as a leading global player in the lithium battery manufacturing equipment industry, competing with other high-end equipment suppliers. It maintains strong partnerships with top-tier battery manufacturers and automotive companies, leveraging its technological innovation and comprehensive product offerings to secure a competitive edge. The company faces intensified competition in the power lithium battery segment but continues to strengthen its market position through innovation and global expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 2.48 billion, a 50.3% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to industry slowdown and strategic order contraction. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.04 billion. Despite the downturn, the company improved operating cash flow to positive RMB 68.7 million. Total assets stood at RMB 8.79 billion with a slight decrease from the prior year, reflecting operational adjustments and asset optimization. R&D investment accounted for 13.55% of revenue, indicating sustained commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lyric Robot Automation emphasizes its unique value through advanced technology integration, high precision, and flexible manufacturing capabilities tailored to the evolving needs of the new energy and semiconductor industries. Its products feature industry-leading innovations such as multi-axis coupling control, laser welding with real-time defect monitoring, and digital twin-enabled smart factory solutions. The company offers comprehensive digital factory solutions that combine hardware and AI-driven software, enabling customers to achieve high efficiency, quality, and customization in battery and semiconductor production.
